technical.summary: ABT shows oversold conditions but lacks bullish confirmation; price is below all major moving averages with negative momentum indicators, making this a weak entry despite oversold RSI levels.

fundamental.summary: ABT shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 7 days present elevated volatility risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Market fear (31 VIX-equivalent) presents contrarian buy opportunity; congressional activity is mixed and non-conviction (junior member, small recent purchases offset by prior sale); no news data to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted curve, VIX 88.5, rising dollar) combined with imminent CPI event and critical earnings binary in 7 days creates compounded risk unsuitable for directional positioning.

debate.key_bull_argument: Oversold RSI (9/14) and Williams %R combined with fear-zone VIX present classic contrarian bounce setup near support at 91.40.
debate.key_bear_argument: Critical earnings binary in 7 days, extreme macro stress (VIX 88.5, inverted yield curve), price below all major moving averages with negative momentum across all indicators, and zero institutional/insider conviction make this a high-risk trap despite oversold technicals.

decision.entry_rationale: Oversold RSI and Williams %R present contrarian setup at support, but this is negated by critical earnings binary in 7 days and extreme macro stress that creates uncompensated tail risk.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 7 days combined with VIX 88.5 and inverted yield curve creates binary event risk that overshadows technical oversold conditions; price below all major moving averages signals structural weakness.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on high risk despite technical oversold signal
